about_the_game:
This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure: a story-driven, point-and-click experience designed for players of all skill levels. You will explore detailed locations, search for carefully hidden objects from a list, and solve a variety of logic puzzles and mini-games that help move the story forward. Observation, curiosity, and attention to detail are the keys to progress.



When people begin drowning in dry rooms, investigator Elijah Reed is pulled into a case that defies logic. Sent to France to look into a series of impossible deaths, he uncovers traces of an ancient legend tied to the sea — a forgotten princess, a sunken city, and a haunting voice that lingers beneath the waves. What starts as a routine investigation quickly turns into something far more dangerous.



Enjoy a wide range of engaging challenges, from classic hidden object scenes to creative mini-games and clever puzzles. Each location offers a fresh test of your attention and reasoning, keeping the experience varied and rewarding!

🗝️ Investigate impossible deaths across eerie French landscapes

🗝️ Uncover Breton folklore and its chilling connection to a sunken city

🗝️ Solve dozens of mini-games and tricky puzzles

🗝️ Explore richly interactive locations filled with secrets

🗝️ Find hidden objects, collectibles, and optional discoveries

🗝️ Use both modern detective methods and arcane tools from Elijah’s occult training

🗝️ Piece together the legend of Dahut and face the truth beneath the waves

🗝️ Earn achievements to highlight your success

🗝️ Make choices that shape the course of the story

Step into a world where myth and investigation collide, and every clue brings you closer to the truth. The answers lie hidden — waiting for those who dare to search.
